blocks.content: Windows install guide (x64 NSIS build): installer walkthrough including the unsigned-build SmartScreen step, the %USERPROFILE%\XtracsysCode data root, Ollama/llama.cpp backend setup with loopback-only URLs, extras (git on PATH, cmd as the agent shell), Windows-specific behavior (taskkill /T tree kill, built-in bsdtar for backups, compound-command approval policy), build-from-source, and the VERIFY_PLATFORM.md per-box checklist. Carries the honest status note: the Windows build is cross-compiled and structurally tested, with on-hardware verification pending (R12).
Builds are unsigned. Current bypass guidance needs artifact-authentication checks and explicit risk framing before public distribution.
